notes.title: Add Hero World 2 To Your Wishlist Now
notes.content:
Join Tom and Lisa in Hero World 2, a thrilling new adventure! Unlike the story-driven first installment, this sequel focuses on helping the duo collect fruits while introducing numerous upgrades and fresh features.



Key Features:

Expanded Wardrobe for Lisa: Lisa now has 6 outfits—3 more than in the first game—for even more variety and customization.

Level Checkpoints: Say goodbye to restarting entire levels! New checkpoints let you pick up right where you left off after a misstep.

Larger Levels: Explore bigger, more detailed levels packed with new challenges and surprises.

Enhanced Gameplay: Every mechanic has been polished to provide a smoother, more enjoyable experience.

Fresh Content and Features: Discover all-new elements that make each level more engaging and dynamic.


Hero World 2 builds on the strengths of the first game, delivering an improved and expanded experience with exciting new challenges. Are you ready to join Tom and Lisa on their fruity adventure?


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3445550/Hero_World_2/
